backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual stock-based compensation, revenue, and gross-profit facts are read from raw SEC Companyfacts tags and are known only by filed date (<= signal date). The current SBC/revenue ratio is compared with the prior annual period using the same SBC tag. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

2_history_check.exp-20260614-029: Rejected diluted-share-count contraction. This run is not a share count threshold; it uses explicit SBC burden versus revenue.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-016: Rejected operating leverage acceleration. This run tests one specific dilution-cost input rather than operating-income outcome.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-003/004/005: Rejected R&D, interest, and tax burden raw Companyfacts scouts. This run uses a distinct shareholder-cost quality field.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-009: Rejected free-cash-flow covered buyback. This run tests reduced compensation dilution burden, not cash-funded repurchases.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-010: Rejected SGA/operating-expense leverage. This run tests dilution quality through SBC burden, not broad cost-line leverage.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: SBC burden improvement is a distinct shareholder-dilution quality field versus recent R&D, SG&A, tax, interest, and buyback scouts; however raw Companyfacts alpha has been saturated and likely fails on window or comparator robustness.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual SBC, revenue, or gross-profit facts, missing prior comparison period, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC tag mapping, filed-date PIT SBC/revenue improvement gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
